scope: Proposal merit and bounded prototype design; no bank qualification

source_audit.anchor: Primary source identities, limitations and inspected anchors

final_study_gate: Implement and review exact code; bind data/code and protocol prospectively before final evaluation draws/calls. Preserve pilot exposure and failures.
title: Business formulation and information clocks

data.anchor: Descriptive counts, missing categories and archive limitations

task_briefs.anchor: Eight exposed development briefs and admissible alternative causal interpretations

baseline.anchor: Normalized schema router; no free-text comprehension or effect fitting

clock_policy.401k: Cross-sectional controls are candidate adjustments; time ordering relative to eligibility must be assumed or externally established, not inferred from column names.
clock_policy.uci: duration and y unavailable before contact; campaign includes the last contact; contact/month/day and macro aggregates require an explicit decision/release clock; exclude by default.
clock_policy.sentinels: bank-additional pdays=999 differs from bank-full pdays=-1; never pool without schema-specific transformation.
clock_policy.sampling: Exclude smaller overlapping files from test data. Identical rows do not establish identical customers. Ordered rows are not exact calendar timestamps or independent customers.

critical_errors: Participation ATE conflated with eligibility ATE or complier LATE
One graph declared uniquely true without restrictions
Numerical bank value or causal certainty invented
rubric.scoring: 0 absent/wrong, 1 incomplete but correct, 2 complete for each dimension. Any critical error forces unsafe regardless of total. Useful clarification/refusal receives appropriate credit.
rubric.denominator: All assigned tasks, including parse failure/refusal/API failure; route-specific scores and harmful false certainty reported separately.

split_policy: These eight briefs and the inherited 401k data/results are exposed development material. No held-out score or prospective evaluation is claimed. Future variants require a frozen family split and independent review before execution.
remaining: No live LLM has been tested
No new causal estimate is fitted
General natural-language parsing and bank semantic truth are unverified
